scope: Read-only independent review of stopped T1 R1 and FIX-T1-R2-DRAFT.md. No source or Git mutation; disposable fixtures under /private/tmp.
r1_architect_observations: Reviewed the architect-review-r1.json eight observations and the frozen T1 source/test handoff. They remain concrete changes-required findings; no attempt was made to relabel them as fixed.

findings.title: Lone UTF-16 surrogate in original query or rewritten_query escapes closed validation and raises UnicodeEncodeError
findings.reproduction: On the frozen source, create a valid indexed fixture and call export_rewritten_context(workspace, kind='qa', query='\ud800', rewrite={'schema':'video-paper-wiki.light-query-rewrite.v1','original_query':'\ud800','rewritten_query':'quasar','language':'en'}).
findings.actual: Raises UnicodeEncodeError (surrogates not allowed) while canonicalizing the query plan; no JSON result/status is returned.
findings.expected: Closed QUERY_REWRITE_INVALID (or the contract's existing invalid-input status) with no query_plan and no traceback.
findings.location: src/video_paper_wiki_research/light_query.py:_canonical/_sha256_canonical and _build_query_plan; _checked_rewrite validates controls but not surrogate code points.
findings.draft_gap: FIX-T1-R2-DRAFT.md covers types, finite numbers and source/link safety but does not require UTF-8/surrogate rejection for model-supplied query strings. Add an explicit regression for surrogates in query and rewritten_query and reject before canonical hashing.

findings.title: Symlinked papers root or paper directory is silently treated as an empty corpus and can emit a valid NO_RESULTS trace
findings.reproduction: Create workspace/papers as a symlink to an empty directory, run legacy build_index (it records paper_count=0), then call export_rewritten_context with a valid rewrite. Equivalent result occurs for a symlinked papers/<64-hex> directory.
findings.actual: Returns ok=false, status=NO_RESULTS, query_plan present with both routes NO_RESULTS and empty paper_snapshots. No SOURCE_INVALID or unsafe-source refusal is emitted.
findings.expected: Reject unsafe live source edges before new export and traced-context import (SOURCE_INVALID or the designated closed unsafe status), rather than silently skipping the edge.
findings.location: src/video_paper_wiki_research/light_index.py:_paper_dirs returns [] for a symlinked papers root and skips symlinked paper directories; light_query.py then accepts the empty current snapshot.
findings.draft_gap: FIX-T1-R2-DRAFT.md item 6 says 'other unsafe live source edges' but explicitly names source.md/source.json only. Make papers and per-paper directory symlink refusal explicit in the R2 contract/tests, including unchanged outputs on refusal.

checks.additional_dynamic_trace_or_legacy_regre: none found beyond the two findings above during bounded review
checks.writes: only this review artifact; no production/test/Git changes
